units: <cite ref="Berakhot 6a:5">Ber. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>מח׳ דידהו</he> from their (the demons’) rubbing against their clothing.
<cite ref="Sukkah 32a:5">Succ. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>דעביד כי ח׳</he> it has the shape of a broom.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 96a:10">B. Kam. 96ᵃ</cite> if one stole palm-leaves <he>ועבדינהו ח׳</he> and made a broom of them. [Ar. <cite ref="E00731"><he>הָפְיָא</he></cite>, Var. <cite ref="E00256"><he>הוּפְיָא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. to Succ. l. c. note 2.]
